summary: Identifies the requirements for certificate lifecycle transactions between IPsec VPN systems using IKE and PKI systems. It is a requirements document and does not define a protocol itself. This memo is informational.

eli5.summary: VPN gear needs digital ID cards and has to request, renew and cancel them. This lists what the process should be able to do so VPN and ID-issuing systems work together.
